prova:
have hCpos : 0 < C := Nat.lt_trans (Nat.zero_lt_one) hC
  have hCge2 : 2 ≤ C := by omega
  set S := { x : ℕ | ∃ p k, Nat.Prime p ∧ p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ = x } with hS_def
  have hS_inf : Set.Infinite S := by
    refine Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem (fun k : ℕ => k) _
    intro k
    have h₁ : 0 < C ^ k := Nat.pow_pos hCpos k
    refine ⟨Nat.exists_infinite_primes' (⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ + 1), ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpp⟩ := this
    refine ⟨p, k, hp, by
      have h₂ : (⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ : ℕ) ≤ (C : ℕ) ^ k := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
      have h₃ : (C : ℕ) ^ k ≤ (C : ℕ) ^ k := le_rfl
      have h₄ : (⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (C : ℝ) ^ k := Nat.cast_floor_le (by positivity)
      have h₅ : (p : ℝ) + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ ≥ (1 : ℝ) + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ := by
        have : (p : ℝ) ≥ 1 := Nat.cast_le (by omega)
        linarith
      have h₆ : (C : ℝ) ^ k ≥ (⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by
        have h₇ : (⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (C : ℝ) ^ k := Nat.cast_floor_le (by positivity)
        have h₈ : (C : ℝ) ^ k - ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ ≥ 0 := by linarith
        have h₉ : (C : ℝ) ^ k - ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ < 1 := by
          exact Nat.sub_lt_of_lt (by linarith) (by
            have := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (by positivity)
            simpa using this)
        linarith
      have h₁₀ : (p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ : ℕ) > (C : ℕ) ^ k := by
        have h₁₁ : (p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ : ℝ) > (C : ℝ) ^ k := by
          linarith
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_cast h₁₁
      have h₁₂ : (C : ℕ) ^ k ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow k hCge2
      have h₁₃ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ > (C : ℕ) ^ k := h₁₀
      have h₁₄ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ ≥ (C : ℕ) ^ k + 1 := by omega
      have h₁₅ : (C : ℕ) ^ k + 1 > (C : ℕ) ^ k := by omega
      have h₁₆ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ > (C : ℕ) ^ k := h₁₃
      have h₁₇ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ ≥ ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ + 1 := by
        have : p ≥ 1 := by omega
        omega
      have h₁₈ : ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ + 1 > (C : ℕ) ^ k := by
        have h₁₉ : (⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ + 1 : ℝ) > (C : ℝ) ^ k := by
          have h₂₀ : (⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 > (C : ℝ) ^ k := by linarith
          exact h₂₀
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_cast h₁₉
      have h₂₁ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ > (C : ℕ) ^ k := h₁₃
      have h₂₂ : p ≥ 1 := by omega
      have h₂₃ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ ≥ 1 + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ := by omega
      have h₂₄ : 1 + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ > (C : ℕ) ^ k := by
        have h₂₅ : (1 + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ : ℝ) > (C : ℝ) ^ k := by
          have h₂₆ : (⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 > (C : ℝ) ^ k := by linarith
          exact h₂₆
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_cast h₂₅
      have h₂₇ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ > (C : ℕ) ^ k := h₁₃
      have h₂₈ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ ≥ (C : ℕ) ^ k + 1 := by omega
      have h₂₉ : (C : ℕ) ^ k + 1 > (C : ℕ) ^ k := by omega
      omega
      have h₃₀ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ > ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ := by
        have : p ≥ 1 := by omega
        omega
      have h₃₁ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ ≥ ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ + 1 := by omega
      have h₃₂ : ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ + 1 > (C : ℕ) ^ k := by
        have h₃₃ : (⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ + 1 : ℝ) > (C : ℝ) ^ k := by
          have h₃₄ : (⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 > (C : ℝ) ^ k := by linarith
          exact h₃₄
        exact Nat.lt_of_lt_cast h₃₃
      have h₃₅ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ > (C : ℕ) ^ k := h₁₃
      have h₃₆ : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ ≥ (C : ℕ) ^ k + 1 := by omega
      omega
    exact this
  have hS_pos : 0 < S.lowerDensity := by
    refine ⟨2, 0, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨by norm_num, by
      have : S.Infinite := hS_inf
      exact Set.Infinite.le_card_filter (fun x hx => by
        obtain ⟨p, k, hp, hsum⟩ := hx
        have : p + ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ ≥ 2 := by
          have hp1 : p ≥ 2 := Nat.Prime.two_le hp
          have : ⌊(C : ℝ) ^ k⌋₊ ≥ 0 := Nat.zero_le _
          omega
        omega
      )
    ⟩
  simpa [hS_def] using hS_pos
